validated_results.title: Vitamin d levels in subjects with prostate cancer compared to age-matched controls.
validated_results.reason: This retrospective case-control study compared serum vitamin D levels between men with prostate cancer and age-matched controls.

extraction.population: Veterans receiving care at the Stratton VA Medical Center

cases.excerpt: Study subjects include 479 with prostate cancer and 473 subjects without prostate cancer.

comparison.excerpt: In this retrospective study, we compared vitamin D levels in subjects with PCa with those of age-matched men without PCa.

design.excerpt: This is a clinical, retrospective study to evaluate vitamin D levels in subjects with or without prostate cancer.

timing.excerpt: This is a clinical, retrospective study to evaluate vitamin D levels in subjects with or without prostate cancer.

continent.excerpt: This study was approved by the Institutional Review Board as well as Research and Development at Stratton VA Medical Center at Albany, NY, USA.

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Subjects included patients whose vitamin D levels had been analyzed at Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN-2) of Veterans Health Administration (VHA) between 2006 and 2009.

parallel_r3_gate_reasons: JBI remains Fair after Claude R2
important quantitative evidence remains missing or invalid: ci_lower, ci_upper, effect_size, effect_type, p_value
